h: VeryDarkMan calls for a probe into how singer B-Red got his car
p: Social media critic VeryDarkMan has reportedly asked the authorities to look into how singer B-Red acquired his car, saying the means was not clean. B-Red has not been reported to have responded, and no agency has confirmed any inquiry.
more: The claim is said to have been made in a fresh online post.
It follows VeryDarkMan's other recent public call-outs of entertainers.
